fallbacks.notes: Entra's SSO tutorial says Contentful supports JIT provisioning; not confirmed on a Contentful page (jit left null).

row.scim_plan: Premium / Enterprise (High Availability or Scale platform)
row.evidence: JumpCloud's Contentful connector requires "A Contentful Premium/Enterprise account on High Availability and Scale platform plans"; Contentful's own pages could not be loaded.
row.notes: Every contentful.com page (pricing, help centre, developer docs) returned a Vercel Security Checkpoint (HTTP 429 JS challenge) to curl, WebFetch and the headless renderer throughout this run, so no Contentful page could be cited. The plan gate comes from JumpCloud's catalogue page (rule 6, low confidence); Entra only says a subscription that supports SCIM is needed. June values not re-verified and dropped: Lite $300/mo flat (20 users) and the Premium/Enterprise Contact Sales price. JumpCloud says deactivating, updating and removing users is not supported, and Okta's app does not list Deactivate, so SCIM may lack deprovisioning; check Contentful's SCIM FAQ when the site is reachable.
